notes.title: Our First Game Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut is Live!
notes.content:
It’s been 5 years since we released Kathy Rain, the first title from Clifftop Games, and launch day for the Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut is finally upon us! We couldn’t be more excited to share our third game with you all — the definite version of Kathy Rain. We believe that KR: DC elevates Kathy’s journey to a whole new level, opening many doors for the future of Kathy Rain!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395030/Kathy_Rain_Directors_Cut/]Grab Kathy Rain: Director's Cut on Steam![/url]

While you wait for the download to start, enjoy our launch trailer below, and as always — thank you for being here. We wouldn’t be able to do this if it wasn’t for all of you, and we sincerely hope that Kathy will bring you some joy in this spooky season!

notes.title: Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut Announcement
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the Director’s Cut of the award-winning adventure Kathy Rain — the new and definite way to experience the rise of an iconic detective.

In the almost five years since Kathy Rain launched, we’ve been blown away by the reception of the game and the passion of the community. Thanks to everyone that has played the game so far, given feedback and shared their experience!

All of this has led us to our mission to create a refined and expanded version of Kathy Rain, created from the ground up in a modern, up-to-date game engine.

We have taken everything we’ve learned during these years to give you the most complete realization of Kathy’s journey yet. Once again, a detective is born...

[previewyoutube=SV5-E0mm7zc;full][/previewyoutube]

For both new and returning visitors to Conwell Springs, there’s lots to look forward to...

[list]
[*] Extended storyline with a prolonged ending, hundreds of lines of additional dialogue, and multiple new areas to explore.
[*] Several new major puzzle chains along with many small additions and tweaks of existing puzzles.
[*] Enlarged game environments to fill up the entire screen without any black bars on the sides.
[*] Countless visual improvements, such as more character animations, better lighting/shadows and extra weather effects.
[*] Streamlined mouse controls with an intuitive single click interface.
[*] Controller support done right. Lean back in your chair and take smooth direct control of Kathy, with no messy cursor getting in the way.
[*] Expanded and remixed soundtrack by the original composer, Daniel Kobylarz.
[*] Five brand new motorcycle designs to unlock and customize the Katmobile with.
[/list]

We’ve still got more to show of Kathy Rain: Director’s Cut, so stay tuned. We’d appreciate you wishlisting the game to show both us and Steam that you’re looking forward to playing!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395030/Kathy_Rain_Directors_Cut/]Wishlist Now[/url]

notes.title: Whispers of a Machine patch v.1.0.3 up!
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Vera will now properly explain why she won't pick up a thing that looks exactly like a thing she is looking for, but, uh... isn't the actual thing.
[*]Put in an additional hint for a puzzle connected to the museum, to try and reduce the number of pitchforks currently wielded outside our office.
[*]Vera no longer receives two copies of a certain key, potentially resulting in various assorted glitches.
[*]Fixed two instances of Vera getting stuck in places and unable to move. She is no longer enchanted to the point of paralysis by sleeping men and certain trash cans.
[*]An adversary will no longer be detected by the bioanalyzer after they left the room when playing on certain graphics settings.
[*]Vera no longer sometimes claims she has picked up imaginary items when searching through containers.
[*]Various improvements and tweaks for the French translation. For instance, "finger" is no longer translated as "should". You're welcome.
[*]Don't allow showing hotspots with tab if shift is held down, to avoid interfering with the Steam overlay.
[/list]

notes.title: Whispers of a Machine patch v.1.0.2 up!
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash on some monitor resolutions when opening the codex.
[*]Fixed a slight music descync during a certain confrontation.
[*]Fixed Vera's idles sometimes triggering in the wrong situations, making her snap out of some animations.
[*]Fixed Vera getting stuck in a crawling state if turning on and off the last empathetic unlock in a certain way.
[*]Fixed Vera giving a muscle boost hint on one occasion before having a reason to use her strength on that object.
[*]Fixed Vera telling a certain character that she fixed a thing before she actually fixed the thing.
[/list]
